items.title: Russian oil refinery runs at 21-year lows after drone attacks, Kpler says
items.description: MOSCOW: Damage caused ‌by Ukrainian drone strikes has reduced Russia’s oil refining volumes to 21-year lows, commodities data and analytics firm Kpler said on Tuesday. Russian refinery crude runs have fallen to around 3.80 million barrels per day to date, the lowest level in well over two decades. items.title: Future Investment Initiative Institute announces 10th edition for October
items.description: RIYADH: The Future Investment Initiative Institute announced that the 10th edition of the event will be held in Riyadh from Oct. 26-29, 2026, under the theme “The Power of Legacy.” The event will also celebrate the 10th anniversary of the initiative’s launch.
